content.user_title: Trigger Deeper Reasoning for Complex Work
content.value_statement: Complex engineering work can suffer from shallow analysis and missed trade-offs. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code escalate reasoning when complexity signals appear.
actual_capabilities: Defines a weighted checklist for complexity signals.
Sets a clear threshold for triggering deeper reasoning.
Provides prompt phrases that request deeper analysis.
Maps deep reasoning to fix, brainstorm, architecture, and sequential-thinking workflows.
Lists situations where proactive deep reasoning is recommended.
limitations: It does not execute code or verify solutions.
It relies on the assistant recognizing context correctly.
It can increase response time and response length.
It does not replace tests, reviews, or domain expertise.

use_cases.title: Architecture Decisions
use_cases.description: Evaluate trade-offs before changing module boundaries, APIs, or deployment patterns.

use_cases.title: Difficult Debugging
use_cases.description: Recheck assumptions after repeated fixes fail to solve a problem.

use_cases.title: Risky Code Changes
use_cases.description: Apply deeper analysis to security, permissions, secrets, or performance-sensitive paths.

prompt_templates.title: Check Complexity
prompt_templates.prompt: Use ultrathink-trigger to score this task's complexity. Explain whether deeper reasoning is needed: [task description].

prompt_templates.title: Deepen Debugging
prompt_templates.scenario: Use after multiple failed fix attempts.
prompt_templates.prompt: I have tried two fixes without success. Ultrathink: identify possible root causes, unchecked assumptions, and the next focused checks for [issue].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Architecture Options
prompt_templates.scenario: Use before choosing a design direction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Ultrathink: compare these architecture options for maintainability, performance, security, and migration risk: [options and constraints].

prompt_templates.title: Plan Cross-Domain Change
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for changes that affect several systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Ultrathink: create a decision-ready analysis for this multi-system change. Include risks, trade-offs, validation steps, and rollback considerations: [change].

output_examples.input: A payment flow change touches frontend, backend, and authorization checks.
output_examples.output: Complexity score: 7. Trigger deeper reasoning because the change spans systems and includes security implications.

output_examples.input: A one-line typo fix in a familiar file.
output_examples.output: Complexity score: 0. Use normal reasoning because the task is simple and low risk.

output_examples.input: Two attempted fixes did not resolve a cache invalidation bug.
output_examples.output: Trigger deeper debugging analysis. Recheck assumptions about cache keys, write timing, and stale reads before changing more code.

best_practices: Calculate complexity before starting broad or risky work.
Use deeper reasoning when security, performance, or breaking changes are involved.
Reassess complexity when the task scope changes.
anti_patterns: Using deep reasoning for simple and familiar tasks.
Skipping deeper analysis after repeated failed fixes.
Treating the complexity score as a substitute for validation.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps an assistant decide when to use deeper reasoning for complex coding and architecture work.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill is guidance in SKILL.md and does not include scripts or executable files.

faq.question: Which tools support it?
faq.answer: It is listed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I use the deep flag?
faq.answer: Use it when a workflow supports the flag and you want deeper analysis regardless of the score.

faq.question: Can it replace tests or review?
faq.answer: No. It supports analysis, but tests and human review are still required for important changes.

faq.question: Why not use it for every request?
faq.answer: Deep analysis can take more time and produce longer responses. Use it when complexity or risk warrants it.
